title: Health Insurance Claim Disputes Filed with MAS or FIDReC and Proportion Resolved in Favour of Policyholders
what_it_is: Health Insurance Claim Disputes Filed with MAS or FIDReC and Proportion Resolved in Favour of Policyholders

sections.label: FIDReC insurance dispute claims
sections.summary: FIDReC completed an average of 246 annual insurance dispute claims from 2022 to 2024, averaging 95 health insurance claims, with 4% ruled for policyholders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Over the same three-year period of between 2022 and 2024, the Financial Industry Disputes Resolution Centre (FIDReC) completed an average of 246 annual mediation and adjudication claims related to disputes on insurance claim liability and amounts awarded.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Of these, an average of 95 were health insurance claims.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Independent assessors ruled in favour of the policyholders in 4% of the health insurance claims.

sections.label: Insurer burden on non-disclosure
sections.summary: Insurers must demonstrate that non-disclosure of a health condition is material to the underwriting outcome before rejecting a claim.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The onus is on the insurers themselves to demonstrate that the non-disclosure of the health condition to a question asked in the application form is material to the underwriting outcome before they reject a claim for non-disclosure.

sections.label: Disputes share of insurance claims
sections.summary: Disputes and complaints reaching FIDReC or MAS represent less than 0.01% of all insurance claims, about one in 10,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The numbers of disputes and complaints that eventually end up in FIDReC or MAS, respectively, represent less than 0.01% of all insurance claims.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, if we think about this one out of every 10,000 claims end up as disputes or complaints, which FIDReC or MAS then addresses.

sections.label: Falling adjudication case numbers
sections.summary: The total number of cases needing adjudication has been dropping over the last few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Because we are seeing that the total number of cases needing adjudication has been dropping over the last few years.

sections.label: FIDReC mediation and adjudication
sections.summary: FIDReC is available if policyholders cannot agree with their insurer, and over 85% of its cases are resolved through mediation or adjudication.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Second, if you cannot agree with your insurer, FIDReC is there.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And over 85% of their cases are resolved through mediation or adjudication, and it remains a very effective channel for Singaporeans.
